summary.intent: Fix CI production builds of the desktop app failing login (email and Google OAuth) due to missing environment variables, by pointing the desktop release workflow at the staging environment instead of an unconfigured production environment.
summary.outcome: Created a chore branch and updated `.github/workflows/desktop-release.yml` to target the `staging` GitHub environment, switching `PRODUCTION_API_URL` to `STAGING_API_URL` and `VITE_ENVIRONMENT` to `staging` across all three jobs.

repo: The repo has two GitHub Actions environments: `staging` (fully configured with vars) and `production` (vars not yet set up).
The desktop release workflow (`desktop-release.yml`) has three jobs, each requiring their own `environment`, `VITE_API_URL`, and `VITE_ENVIRONMENT` fields to be updated.
The `staging` environment maps `VITE_ENVIRONMENT=staging` to DEVNET automatically via a `NETWORK_MAP`, making an explicit network override unnecessary.

code.finding: Three separate jobs each had `environment: production`, `PRODUCTION_API_URL`, and `VITE_ENVIRONMENT: production` — all three needed updating to staging equivalents.

workflow: A 'Load failed' error on email login in Electron/desktop apps often indicates an empty `VITE_API_URL` — the fetch target resolves to an empty string.
'Google Client ID not configured (VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)' is a reliable signal that a GitHub Actions environment variable (`vars.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`) is not set in the target environment.

friction: DNS resolution failure (`Could not resolve host: github.com`) blocked `git pull` — likely a transient network issue in the dev environment.
An earlier PR (#461) had to be closed and recreated as PR #462 due to scope issues (web release version was incorrectly included).
User had to interrupt an in-progress tool call when the assistant started switching to the wrong branch before being redirected to create a chore branch.
open_items: The GitHub `production` environment still has no variables configured — `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`, `PRODUCTION_API_URL`, and `VITE_WEB3AUTH_CLIENT_ID` need to be set before any real production release.
PR #462 (desktop bump to 0.40.0) includes a `NETWORK_MAP` change that is now redundant given this workflow fix — should be cleaned up.
There is no real production deployment yet; the project is still fully running against staging/devnet infrastructure.
